title: Late-Claim Event Share by Days After the Purchase Day — Finch Circle Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** In a late credit of Finch Circle Loyalty Program points on a missing-points request, the late-claim event share is read from the calendar days from the claimed unit's purchase date to the request date: more than 60 days gives none (0), more than 30 and up to 60 days gives one half (0.5), and 30 days or fewer gives the whole (1).

## Questions answered

**What is counted?** Calendar days, from the purchase date on the claimed unit's purchase record up to the request date.

**What share does a request made exactly 30 days after the purchase date carry?** The whole (1): 30 days or fewer gives the whole.

**And 31 days?** One half (0.5): more than 30 and up to 60 days.

**And exactly 60 days?** Still one half (0.5).

**And 61 days?** None (0): more than 60 days.

## Boundary table

| Calendar days from the purchase date to the request date | Late-claim event share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | 1 |
| 31 to 60 | 0.5 |
| 61 or more | 0 |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

Purchase date 1 March. A request on 31 March is 30 days later (share 1); on 30 April, 60 days later (share 0.5); on 1 May, 61 days later (share 0).
